notes.title: Get Ready to Break Through Space 🚀
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that our brick-breaking odyssey, [b]Galactic Breakout[/b], will officially launch on Steam this [b]January 31st[/b]! For just a symbolic price, you can embark on a journey through the cosmos, testing your reflexes across 75 challenging levels, each one brimming with unique obstacles and surprises.

See you in the stars,
Trident Peak
